name: Arrow
overview: Scripture presents the arrow as both a literal and figurative instrument of God's power and human action. Arrows were used in hunting and war, symbolizing strength and divine judgment, as seen in God's promise to 'spend mine arrows upon them' and to make them 'drunk with blood' against enemies. Notably, arrows also served as signs in communication, such as Jonathan's shooting to signal David and Joash's use against the Syrians, highlighting their role beyond mere weaponry to convey God's purposes and protection.
